text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Working adults.
Daily workers contributing, giving all, holding down fort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Occasional downtime needed nonetheless.
Touch of luxury should be permitted!
And so...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Time for rewards!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Mini-vacation at resort...
Fufu, took quite bold step myself♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leaving daily exhaustion right here!
Time to spoil ourselves completely!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Dining while watching sea... simply wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, juicy roast beef...
Tasted just like reward...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Next up, spa and massage!
Time to get smooth and radiant!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hoooh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Lomi lomi, head spa...
Thought I would melt away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, paired with this...
Beverage, and sunset.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Truly... luxury exclusive to being grown-up.
Or something like that, fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
Dusk over ocean is gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um, care for walk?
Before we melt completely.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~... Sea breeze feels wonderful.
Crisp feel of sand crunching underfoot, too...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Fufu, tickles child inside, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...So nostalgic.
Back when I was at the academy, during summer camp,
we used to play at the beach together.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, current students do that too.
Burying friends in the sand, building castles,
chasing each other along the water's edge...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we did! Totally did~!
Ah, brings back memories...
choice_data_list: That's really fun once you actually try it, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Right, right, once you start, you get totally absorbed in it...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Eehh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Are we... really doing this?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...It's not every day we get a chance, is it?
choice_data_list: No rule says adults can't do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Heck with it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We dashed over to the water's edge.
Foamy white waves burst at our feet,
spraying droplets across our faces.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Kyah, fufu!
Ah, that feels wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san! Catch me if you can~!
Just kidding, fufu!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, let's run!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure about that?
I'm going to give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Huh?
Did I get out of shape...? She caught me so easily.
choice_data_list: I was taken down in seconds.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I couldn't help myself♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haa... fufu.
I got carried away, acting way too young for my age.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, isn't that wonderful though?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how old you get,
being able to lose yourself in something is a beautiful thing.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Lose yourself in something, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm sure it doesn't matter what that thing is.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Being able to do what you want, when you want to.
Having things you feel like trying.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —And fully enjoying that very moment with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Living passionately in the present moment.
Perhaps that's what people call...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the train, wrapped in pleasant exhaustion,
everyone fell naturally silent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, we will live with all our might again.
So for now, quietly. Just like this...
